_doc: The drowned tower under Oruvel: small shoals hang in the crown, the bell-room and the galleries, and dart off when Rhen comes near. Underwater, so no gulls or crabs. The rooms' floors are y 0 under 3 m walls. Placed on the greybox layout (M3-CRE-615); move the coordinates when env-art's kit replaces the blocks (same keys as ch02_haluna.json).
